name: Documentation {OS}
tagline: Write it once, find it later, keep it true.

commands.name: /doc-map
commands.summary: Inventory the set: what exists, where, who owns it, when it was last verified.

commands.name: /doc-write
commands.summary: Write one document to the house shape, with its four required fields.

commands.name: /doc-find
commands.summary: Answer a question and cite the document and verified date it came from.

commands.name: /doc-verify
commands.summary: Check a document against reality: confirm, correct, or report drift to its owner.

commands.name: /doc-merge
commands.summary: Collapse duplicates into one surviving document with redirects.

commands.name: /doc-retire
commands.summary: Archive a document reversibly and point its entry points at the replacement.

commands.name: /doc-index
commands.summary: Repair findability: titles, entry points, naming and search terms.

commands.name: /doc-stale
commands.summary: List what has passed its review date, by owner, ranked by risk.

requires_human_approval_for: merging two documents with different owners
editing a document owned by someone else
publishing anything to an audience outside the team
changing a document that encodes a policy
rewriting content where reality and the document disagree
